usage: deskops drawer remove [-h] [--root ROOT] [--force] [--reason REASON]
                             [--ref REF]
                             selector

Remove one drawer entry (a file, an issue with its assets, or a whole plan
directory), its tracking, and its bullets on the drawer board.

positional arguments:
  selector         Drawer file selector. Selectors accept an exact id,
                   filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      Target repository root
  --force          Remove even when a task in desk/tasks/ records the entry in
                   from_drawer.
  --reason REASON  Why the entry is removed; printed with the result.
  --ref REF        Commit or file that replaces or resolves the entry;
                   repeatable.
